name: L'IMAD (Abu Dhabi sovereign investor, formerly ADQ)
via: Sovereign investor of the Government of Abu Dhabi; absorbed ADQ in 2026; chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed (The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05)
note: UAE Team L'IMAD sponsor page: 'L'IMAD is a sovereign investor of the Government of Abu Dhabi.' Cyclingnews (2026-07-27): Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund reportedly worth about $300bn, chaired by Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan; ADQ absorbed into L'IMAD. The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) says the fund is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed. Chair accounts differ between sources.
